item.text: I’m checking Mistral’s current official model and API documentation to distinguish hosted reranking from embedding or generation endpoints.

No—Mistral does not currently document a dedicated hosted reranker model or `/rerank` API endpoint.

Mistral provides:

- A hosted embeddings endpoint, [`POST /v1/embeddings`](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/embeddings), for models such as `mistral-embed`.
- A Python Search Toolkit with reranking components (`LLMReRanker`, `CrossEncoderReRanker`, and `RRFRanker`), but these are toolkit components you configure and can replace with your own—not a standalone Mistral-hosted reranker endpoint. [Search Toolkit documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit)

You could implement LLM-based reranking by calling a Mistral chat model yourself, or use a third-party/self-hosted cross-encoder reranker.
